item.title: Re: Executioner from the wild west
item.content:encoded:
Hey there, Cog! I'm new as well but I read the guide for how to use this forum and they ask that you don't post links to sandboxes unless a reviewer asks. To pitch an idea here they want you to use the following template I will paste in to this comment. Rather than starting a new thread simply edit the content of this one by clicking options and selecting the edit feature. Also I recommend you check out the posts at the top of this forum for the guide that tells you how to use this forum. They pretty supportive community here, but they are pretty strict about formatting and organization so just give it that newbie guide a once over. It also has cool tips in there for finding more reviewers ;)

Here is the template you should use for your idea pitch. Make sure the last four sections contain no more than 400 words combined.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes or No

Page Type: SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify)

Genre (Optional): Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify)

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch:

Central Narrative:

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

Additional Notes:
